docs.summary: Entry point for the Prowl Editor application. Parses command-line arguments and either runs a headless build or launches the editor UI.
If set via --project arg, the editor opens this project directly (skips launcher).
If set via --buildmode arg, the editor runs a build directly and doesn't start any UI.
If set via --output arg, it builds the game into this path when built through the --build arg.
Application entry point. Installs a crash reporter, parses arguments, then either starts a headless build (if --buildmode was passed) or launches the editor window.
